explication: anyapk is an Android APK installer that uses local wireless ADB to install APKs and split bundles. The main workflow is selecting or opening a package, preparing it for the device, then installing it through an ADB session; pairing establishes that connection through Developer Options and a notification reply. The graph also includes settings and self-updating. Relationships are grounded in the README and supplied source-index references or excerpts; unsampled internals are not expanded beyond those references.
